name: PrivacyPilot
author: Andreas Kasper

sections.description:
Privacy policy, cookie policy, terms and imprint generated from a questionnaire and a centrally maintained, signed clause library, plus a consent banner with script blocking, Google Consent Mode v2, GPC support, a request form and Site Health checks. US and EU/UK, English and German.

PrivacyPilot is not legal advice.
sections.installation: Download the ZIP from the GitHub releases page and upload it under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin. Then open Settings → PrivacyPilot.
sections.changelog:
Changelog

0.9.261109

  • First version: documents EN/DE from the clause library, questionnaire, approval workflow, hub/client, consent banner with geo rules, GPC and Consent Mode v2, script and embed blocking, scanner, cookie audit, request form, consent log, Site Health tests, Termageddon migration.
  • Admin in English and German.
  • Signed library feed (Ed25519, key 1).
  • Warnings when answers contradict the services in use (e.g. an advertising pixel without "sharing").
  • Asset URLs carry the file time, so CDNs never serve an outdated banner script.
